Name: Kenneth's Daily Breakfast
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Daily Breakfast[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Gives your farmer breakfast every morning, if you are up early.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because I like the idea of my farmer waking up and having something small to eat before starting the day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is just a small breakfast, nothing big. You go outside in the morning and it will be in your bag.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]There are two versions, you can use one or both.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Bread and milk, if you want something simple and light. You get a plated small baguette and a tall milk bottle.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Bread and coffee, if you want something warm to start the day. You get a plated mini bread loaf and a hot white coffee.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Breakfast is available from 6am to 8:59am. If you go outside during that time, you will get it. If you stay inside or wake up late and miss it, you will have to wait for the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If your bag is full, check the lost and found at the mayor's house. It usually ends up there.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It works on a new save or an existing save. After you install it, sleep one night and it will start the next morning.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Restaurant and Kenneth's Drink Shop, plus SMAPI and Content Patcher. That is all.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to add or remove anytime, no need for a new save.[/b][/size]
